adjudications.reason: Exception and purity catalogs provide domain-specific parsers and factories to the shared loader, entry map, and trust context; the remaining overlap is adapter configuration.
Normal-completion and using-entry contexts call one throw-guard transfer service with distinct evidence provenance.
The retained compact schemas expose the same SMT diagnostics in two compatible result shapes; both are populated from one snapshot.
The internal resolved analysis target and public result carry matching source coordinates but represent input ownership and output API state respectively.
Capability and complexity operations configure one shared source-input dispatcher with different analyzers and error contracts.
Distinct control-flow contexts invoke the canonical loop invariant transfer with context-specific provenance.
A partial-type caller passes the exception-analysis context to its site-collection stage; no decision logic is duplicated.
The typed public facade forwards proof context to the internal source-query pipeline; proof behavior remains in the shared service.
